```{r setup}
library(bioRtools)
```

`find_outliers()` applies a reproducible univariate outlier rule and can return
either the filtered values or a logical index.

```{r}
data(test_data)

outliers <- find_outliers(test_data$Sepal.Length)
head(outliers)
```
